shellPasses.title: Physical shell comment boundaries preserve literal separator data
Native first shell directive wins
Ordinary comment backslash does not continue the next directive
Bounded header does not read a distant annotation
Ambient ShellCheck options cannot change deterministic policy
Explicit native ash basename remains supported as BusyBox dialect
Unsupported shell source remains a visible coverage failure
Header analysis pragma does not activate foreign interpreter source
ANSI-C quoted tab data survives native formatting
Quoted process substitution remains a native shell expression
Here-string data survives native formatting
Unquoted heredoc expansion survives native formatting
Cached shell syntax trees do not share mutable result objects
Custom Actions command template propagates shell options
Foreign Actions interpreter skips shell analyzers
Invalid custom command payload fails analysis coverage
Disabled Compose healthcheck remains inert
Kubernetes argv projection preserves direct shell command
Local exact-code directive remains effective with native execution prefix
Shell diagnostic byte positions preserve Unicode comment data
Check cd before acting on a relative directory
Preserve literal backslashes when reading input
Variable does not store shell quotation semantics
Remote heredoc expansion belongs to remote runtime
Prevent empty path interpolation during recursive removal
Keep last exit status attached to the tested command
Append block once instead of opening the same file repeatedly
Test numeric values with numeric comparison
Avoid accidental pattern match in case glob
Pinned local corpora preserve native ownership and bounded process isolation

admissions.failureMode: Unicode/control separators inside one comment become fake header comments
admissions.reproduction: native shfmt accepts six literal separator forms; adapter falsely exempts them as generated, and falsely selects Bash from comment data
admissions.owner: textlint.shell_header_comments, shared by shell_dialect and shell_format.is_generated
admissions.gap: Python str.splitlines treats literal shell comment data as physical source line boundaries
admissions.harm: Authored files bypass the formatter or use an unintended parsing dialect
admissions.invalidStateVersusPreference: Generated marker and analysis-directive recognition require actual header comment lines; no style preference is added
admissions.smallestFix: Split the bounded shell header at LF only; keep existing trimming and CRLF compatibility

admissions.repro: pytest_plugins = shared = ("tests.test_api",) produces zero SARJ426 diagnostics; ordinary single assignment reports one
admissions.gap: The ast.Assign match requires exactly one target
admissions.harm: Literal test-module plugin imports retain collection cycles/order coupling while escaping the existing invariant
admissions.invalidState: The same literal test-module plugin declaration is already disallowed; chained assignments do not alter pytest_plugins ownership
admissions.fix: Inspect every direct Name assignment target; preserve dynamic-value exclusions

admissions.repro: Native prefer-pytest-fixture-injection examples fail from an aliased TemporaryDirectory root and pass from its canonical root
admissions.gap: The native example runner supplies an unresolved temporary-root alias; bounded source resolution correctly rejects it before any ancestor comparison
admissions.harm: A declared valid multi-file rule example fails verification on aliased temporary storage
admissions.invalidState: Normalize the runner-owned virtual workspace without changing source resolver symlink exclusions
admissions.fix: Resolve the newly created temporary root once before writing and analyzing its virtual files

admissions.repro: Two published project-rule positive examples fail natively and pass when their tests package has __init__.py
admissions.gap: Declared virtual files omit the package identity needed by the documented first-party contract proof
admissions.harm: maintain rules verify rejects the rules own public examples
admissions.invalidState: Repair incomplete example context; preserve conservative unresolved-module exclusions
admissions.fix: Declare the tests package marker in both positive and negative virtual fixtures

admissions.repro: Three selected rules and one adjacent rule independently scan all cached AST nodes to compute the same wildcard-import boolean
admissions.owner: PythonFileContext and python:no-positional-tuple-record, python:prefer-match-exception-dispatch, python:prefer-nominal-id-types, python:prefer-non-nullable-collection
admissions.gap: Four byte-equivalent helper implementations repeat broad immutable-source scans despite the existing type-indexed context
admissions.harm: Repeated traversal on every checked module; identical facts can drift independently
admissions.invalidState: No new guard or preference; existing all-scope wildcard exclusion is preserved
admissions.fix: One lazy cached context fact using the existing ImportFrom node bucket; admit only after equal-results baseline measurement
admissions.validation: Identical private finding tuples on the paired pinned corpus; 395 owning tests pass; interleaved native four-rule benchmark measures lower combined and cold medians with equal diagnostics.

adjacentOwnerChange.reason: Fourth identical wildcard-import scan consolidated with the three selected owners

pythonCorpusComparison.reason: Exclude changed source inventories from both sides; original pins retained; no source revision or digest refreshed.
pythonCorpusComparison.method: Seeded sample of at most 250 tracked Python files per repository, isolated native process per repository batch. Exact path/location/code/message tuples compared privately.

performance.method: Four interleaved before/after process pairs; AB, BA, AB, BA. Same interpreter and dependency environment; before restores only the five affected Python source files. Seven samples per process; 28 fresh child processes per side.

makeVerify.privateReferenceGate: Native local target delegates the private-reference scan to trusted CI; verify it on the exact PR head before merge.

validation.publication: Planned after authoring merge; exact manifests and sibling pins are bumped together.
validation.consumerRollout: Planned after publication; five previously registered consumers retain automatic merge disabled.

limitations: Source review used machine-assisted inventory and duplicate-function analysis, with manual probes concentrated on admitted candidates; it is not a claim of exhaustive human review of 190 rules.
Repeated random draws rerun the same declared examples and do not establish additional independent semantic coverage.
The performance fixture is one synthetic 42,854-byte Python module; timing results do not establish a universal speedup.
Native shell corpus findings and pre-existing formatter/coverage failures were unchanged; this run does not claim those findings were fully classified.
No existing Bash script was rewritten in this run.
upstreamOwnersRetained: Existing AST index and native rule-example runners
integrationNote: Rebased onto the independently merged IaC environment-template fix; the affected selected IaC rule was reverified after rebase.
